metrics_finding.finding: inventory-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization remained stable.

evidence_summary.summary: Inventory service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization remained stable.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor inventory service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be an increase in CPU utilization of the inventory service, which has resulted in failure. Further investigation is required to determine the underlying cause.
report_text.hi: संकट की घटना के पीछे मान्यता है कि स्टोरेज सेवा की प्रोसेसर उपयोग बढ़ गया है, जिससे विफल हो गई। औरन्तिम परीक्षण की आवश्यकता है कि यह समस्या क्या है।
